name: Wolf
overview: The Bible portrays the wolf as a symbol of ravenous and destructive force, often associated with predatory behavior and enemies of the righteous, as seen in Genesis 49:27 and Ezekiel 22:27 where wolves devour prey and shed blood for gain. However, Scripture also uses the wolf figuratively to illustrate the reconciling power of the gospel, envisioning a future peace where wolves dwell harmoniously with lambs (Isaiah 11:6; 65:25). This dual imagery highlights both the threat posed by wolves and the transformative hope found in God's kingdom.
